This is the exact same documented cross-process bpm-default realm race independently reproduced by TEST-DESIGNER (step-12) and TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (step-13); verified the stack trace and failing test names match rather than assuming. issues: Full-suite run is sensitive to sibling-session Postgres connection contention on the shared letflow-postgres-1 container (port 5462): a concurrent worktree's own mix test run can exhaust max_connections=100 and abort most partitions with 'too_many_connections' before any test code runs. Not an ISS-0771 defect; noting for awareness, not filing a new issue since docker-compose.yml's port-sharing behavior is already documented as intentional per-workspace design.
